caption: The drawing depicts a metallic ornamental object with an elaborate design. On the left side, there is an oval, ring-like structure that appears to be bronze or gold in color, featuring decorative patterns resembling stylized floral or foliage motifs along its outer edge. Attached to this structure is a sweeping, curved decorative element that branches out with large, leaf-like forms, each vein of the "leaves" highlighted by fine line details. This curvilinear leaf section extends to the right, where it ends in a small, cylindrical fitting, likely meant for attachment to another surface. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, providing contrast that emphasizes the browns and muted golds of the object’s metallic surfaces. The artist's name, "JOHN. H. TERCUZZI.", is printed in small uppercase letters toward the lower left side of the image.
title: Lamp Bracket
